core.title: 12 Inch Skeleton Key Mortise Iron Lockset With Half Round Knob, Acorn WUTBI

text.description_html:
ACORN-WUTBI, Mortise Skeleton Lockset.

Made for interior doors, this is a skeleton key lockset. Using a skeleton key opens up the imagination to a world full of secret rooms and hidden treasures, just like the movies!

The keys look old, but the mortise lock is modern technology.

Operated by a key on both the inside and the outside

Unlike a simple tubular latch, this mortise lock is extremely durable and has a tighter clearance tolerance. You know it's a mortise lock when you hear that heavy, smooth, solid 'click' when the door closes shut.

This old world styling duplicates that found on the ironwork of many European castles and cathedrals and imitates the natural weathering of iron.

Features of Mortise Door Lock:

  • Height: 12"
  • Width: 2-1/2"
  • Projection: 2"
  • Backset: 2-1/2"
  • Knob Style: round
  • Finish: Rough Black Iron

When Selecting the Handing:

The handing actually refers to the mortise lock, rather than the knob.
